The train is beside the platform, behind her running lane. Select one target sliding doorway ahead of her and preserve its placement relative to roof supports and floor seams. Keep the running lane clear; no track crossing.

No illustration, game screenshot, plastic skin, excessive bloom, or baked-in cinematic motion blur. Reference assets should be sharp enough to inspect. No decorative watermarks; the official contest watermark will be added during final editing.
